summary: Isolate fleet handoff checkpoints under handoff base_dir (stop test/deploy pollution of .agentic/checkpoints that paused PM); harden SPEC audit to skip host slash-commands/ellipsis and alias plugin/.mcp.json; align SPEC architecture with payload import, SPEC audit followups, loop budget hydrate, and fleet accept-dispatch (#644/#648/#338/#340).
migration_impact: Local only: existing junk pending Deploy-prod checkpoints under .agentic/checkpoints/ may be cancelled (gh plate checkpoint decide <id> --decision cancel) or deleted; directory is now gitignored like other ephemeral .agentic runtime state. SPEC path wording and audit heuristics change; no template payload force-copy.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core / pull release branch containing this fix.
2. If plate_pm_status or autonomy shows open_checkpoints from test Deploy prod handoffs, cancel them: gh plate checkpoint list --open then decide cancel.
3. Re-run gh plate spec-audit; stale /loop /mcp findings should clear; remaining undocumented findings need real SPEC intent updates.
4. Optional: rm -rf .agentic/checkpoints/ after cancelling if only local test debris remains.
agent_notes: create_handoff(base_dir=...) now writes checkpoints to base_dir/checkpoints. Never create high-risk fleet handoffs against the real repo root during unit tests. SPEC is human-owned; this PR only fixes false path citations and documents already-landed surfaces.
